### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. retinitis pigmentosa 12  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.784)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2343)

**Proposed mechanism:** CRB1 (HGNC:2343) —DISRUPTS→ Photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0035572); Photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0035572) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000547); Photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0035572) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal photoreceptor outer segment morphology (HP:0030056). Loss-of-function mutations in CRB1 disrupt the normal development and maintenance of photoreceptor outer segments, leading to retinal degeneration and abnormal photoreceptor outer segment morphology, manifesting as both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic gain-of-function variant in CRB1 associated with either disease, or the absence of any CRB1 variants in individuals with these phenotypes. _(variant: Exome Variant Server (EVS) or gnomAD data showing a high frequency (>1%) of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in the general population.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CRB1 in photoreceptor integrity offers a potential therapeutic target for both MONDO:0013453 and retinitis pigmentosa 12, suggesting that interventions aimed at restoring CRB1 function or downstream pathways could benefit patients with either condition.
